_comment: Hand reconciliation of Wikidata's three 'The Truth' items (TASKS D-08, PRD §13). Q7770602 is the merged item and holds the IMDb id (tt0408347) and the enwiki article; Q50280249/Q50280253 are empty split shells with no identifiers. Ruling: drop the shells, and at merge time both TVmaze rows (The Truth 1/2) take their identifiers from Q7770602 — mirroring the two-parter policy of duplicating Wikipedia's merged values across both rows.
